title: Topology-aware rollout slate and tenant cost signal for Private Clusters
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, topology-aware rollout surface for Private Clusters that surfaces per-tenant cost signals (egress, burst GPUs, cross-region traffic) alongside network rollout controls. The goal is to let operators run canary and progressive rollouts while seeing immediate cost and connectivity impact for the affected subnets/tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Compact rollout card shows affected subnets and tenant count
Cost delta estimate displayed for canary percentage and projected 24h cost
Network risk badges for subnets with restricted egress or single AZ
Rollout controls allow canary by subnet, by tenant tag, or global
Preview of fallback model/variant mapping when capacity or latency SLOs trigger
Exportable rollout report for SRE and billing teams
comments: 2026-02-12 - Maya Chen: Initial concept sketches uploaded. Focused on minimal chrome so operators can compare cost vs. latency on a single surface.
2026-02-16 - Arjun Patel (Eng): Feasibility note - per-subnet cost estimates will require telemetry rollup work in runtime. Suggest we expose conservative estimates until rollup is completed.
2026-02-19 - Sofia Martinez: Updated mocks to include 'Network Risk' badge (green/amber/red) with hover details explaining single-AZ and peering limits.
2026-02-24 - PM review (Liam O'Connor): Wants a link to billing export and clearer CTA for scheduling canary windows. Also asked for a non-destructive dry-run preview mode.
2026-02-28 - Design critique: Reduce copy in the card; replace absolute cost with delta and projected hourly burn. Add option to show token-level cost for models in canary.
2026-03-03 - Security (Priya Rao): Concern about showing tenant identifiers in shared consoles. Recommend anonymized tenant labels by default and an opt-in detail view for authorized users.
2026-03-05 - Engineering (Arjun Patel): Implementing canary by tenant tag looks straightforward; per-socket egress cost needs new exporter. Marking dependency ENG-90112.
2026-03-09 - Prototype user test (SRE team): Feedback - 'Helpful to see rollback ETA and automatic fallback mapping. We'd like a compact timeline of past rollouts for that cluster.'
2026-03-12 - Sofia Martinez: Updated prototype with dry-run mode, anonymized tenant labels, and a compact past-rollouts mini-timeline. Pushing for security review and eng feasibility sign-off.
2026-03-12 - Maya Chen: Added suggested copy for tooltips and accessibility notes (color contrast and keyboard nav).
tradeoffs: Surface-level cost estimates improve operator visibility but risk inaccuracies until telemetry rollups are complete; mitigated with conservative estimates and clear disclaimers
Showing tenant IDs speeds troubleshooting but increases exposure; resolved with anonymized default and explicit reveal for authorized roles
Packing many signals into a single card could overwhelm new users; addressed by progressive disclosure (overview -> details pane)
decisions: Use delta-first cost display (projected additional cost for selected canary) rather than absolute spend
Default to anonymized tenant labels, add 'reveal' action gated by RBAC
Include an exported CSV/JSON report for billing reconciliation
Expose a dry-run preview that simulates traffic routing and cost impact without changing runtime rules
